# AI Trading Tools

A sourced list of AI trading agents, broker MCP servers, market data APIs, Telegram bots, agent wallets and exchanges. Every fact and score is copied from the [TradingAgentStack](https://tradingagentstack.com) open dataset.

**134 tools.** Dataset generated **2026-10-25**. Newest listing check: **2026-10-25**.

Not financial advice. Verify details with each vendor before connecting real money.

## How scores work

The [safety score](https://tradingagentstack.com/safety-score/) is a 0 to 100 measure of what a tool can do with your money. It is built from seven sourced inputs: whether it can place live orders unattended, whether order approval exists, whether paper, demo or testnet is available, whether it can withdraw or transfer funds, whether keys can be scoped, whether the code is open source, and whether the facts come from the vendor. When an input is missing, the listing is marked **partial** and the percentage is the points earned out of the points that could be checked. Affiliate links never affect the score.

Crypto agent tools (agent wallets, DeFi and Telegram bots, exchanges, and similar) may also show an [Agent Risk Score](https://tradingagentstack.com/methodology/#agent-risk-score). That column is filled only where TradingAgentStack has published a v2 score. The percentage is the published points divided by the points that could be checked, rounded to the nearest whole number.

## Sibling projects

- **[tradingagentstack-mcp](https://tradingagentstack.com/mcp/)** (npm package `tradingagentstack-mcp`): read-only MCP server for this directory. Hosted endpoint: `https://tradingagentstack.com/api/mcp`. Source: [intoApex/tradingagentstack-mcp](https://github.com/intoApex/tradingagentstack-mcp).
- **[TAS Guard](https://tradingagentstack.com/guard/)**: open-source limits, approvals and a kill switch between an AI agent and a broker MCP server or wallet. Source: [intoApex/tas-guard](https://github.com/intoApex/tas-guard).
- **[TAS Ratings](https://github.com/intoApex/tas-ratings)**: the same open data, including Agent Risk Scores, incidents and guard profiles, under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

A small stdio server in [`mcp-server/`](mcp-server/) reads `data/tools.json` from this repo.

## Data source and license

The tool records in this repository come from the public dataset at [tradingagentstack.com/data](https://tradingagentstack.com/data/):

- [`data/tools.json`](data/tools.json) is [tools.json](https://tradingagentstack.com/data/tools.json), with the same records and indentation added so the file is reviewable. It includes every tool, safety inputs, Agent Risk Scores where they exist, the incident list and TAS Check records.
- [`data/tools.csv`](data/tools.csv) is [tools.csv](https://tradingagentstack.com/data/tools.csv).

The same JSON is mirrored in [intoApex/tas-ratings](https://github.com/intoApex/tas-ratings). [`.github/workflows/sync-dataset.yml`](.github/workflows/sync-dataset.yml) runs [`scripts/sync_from_site.py`](scripts/sync_from_site.py) every Monday and commits only when the dataset or this README changes.

The dataset is licensed under [CC BY 4.0](LICENSE). Credit **TradingAgentStack (tradingagentstack.com)** and link to the site. Not financial advice.

## Contributing

This list is regenerated from the public dataset, so corrections belong upstream. Open an issue here, or send the official source through [tradingagentstack.com/submit](https://tradingagentstack.com/submit/). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
